item.title: Friday Is The Last Day To File To Run In The May Primary
item.description: The deadline to file to run in the May Primary Election is approaching. Candidates have until noon on Friday, February 6, to file. Voters in Knox County will have several contested races on the Republican primary ballot.

item.title: Medical Debt Protections Gain Bipartisan Support
item.description: Added support for people with medical debt could soon become law in Indiana. A bill moving through the statehouse would set new rules aimed at protecting patients and improving access to payment options. Medical debt in Indiana

item.title: Substitute Teacher Facing Charges Involving a Minor
item.description: Washington police arrested a substitute teacher following an investigation into reported inappropriate conduct.
